name: zmodel_const_add_or_merge_vertex
description: zModel_Const::AddOrMergeVertex merges points within the recovered vertex epsilon and appends unmatched points to the zDi vertex array.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the epsilon merge and append paths. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482720 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx, point in edx, and return of the existing or appended vertex index, or -1 before append on the warning path.

Binary Ninja assembly validates epsilon comparisons of the absolute coordinate deltas against g_zModel_ConstVertexMergeEpsilon, realloc growth of self->verts, and incrementing self->vertCount after append.
Binary Ninja data at 0x4e1398 validates g_zModel_ConstVertexMergeEpsilon as 0.001f and data at 0x4d2ab8 validates the recovered vertex warning threshold as the double value 921.6.
The native smoke verifies first append, within-epsilon merge without count growth, and outside-epsilon append through the production vertex array.
